tests.desc: Full-length CBT mock covering J&K GK, General English, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, and Computer Awareness as per latest JKSSB syllabus.

qs.t: Which river is known as the lifeline of the Kashmir Valley?
qs.e: The Jhelum (anciently Vitasta) originates at Verinag and flows through the Kashmir Valley.

qs.t: Which mountain pass connects Srinagar with Leh in Ladakh?
qs.e: Zoji La is a high mountain pass on NH-1 connecting Kashmir Valley with Dras and Leh.

qs.t: Who authored the 12th-century Sanskrit chronicle of Kashmir, Rajatarangini?
qs.e: Kalhana composed Rajatarangini ("River of Kings") between 1148 and 1150 CE.

qs.t: The Hangul (Kashmir Stag) is critically conserved in which National Park?
qs.e: Dachigam National Park near Srinagar is the primary protected habitat of the Kashmir Stag.

qs.t: In which year was the Jammu and Kashmir Reorganisation Act enacted by Parliament?
qs.e: The J&K Reorganisation Act was passed in August 2019 and took effect on 31 October 2019.

qs.t: Choose the correct synonym of "METICULOUS":
qs.e: "Meticulous" means showing great attention to detail; thorough and precise.

qs.t: If a train 180 m long passes a pole in 9 seconds, what is its speed in km/h?
Which shortcut key in MS Excel opens the "Format Cells" dialog box?
qs.e: Pressing Ctrl + 1 opens the Format Cells dialog box in Microsoft Excel.

extraction_results.t: Which river feeds the Wular Lake, one of the largest freshwater lakes in Asia located in Jammu & Kashmir?
extraction_results.e: Wular Lake in Bandipora district of Jammu & Kashmir is fed by the Jhelum River, which flows through it.

extraction_results.t: Who built the famous Martand Sun Temple in Jammu & Kashmir?
extraction_results.e: The Martand Sun Temple near Anantnag was built by Lalitaditya Muktapida of the Karkota dynasty in the 8th century CE.

extraction_results.t: Under the Jammu and Kashmir Reorganisation Act, 2019, the erstwhile state was bifurcated into which two Union Territories?
extraction_results.e: The Jammu and Kashmir Reorganisation Act, 2019 bifurcated the state into the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir and the Union Territory of Ladakh.

extraction_results.t: Dachigam National Park in Jammu & Kashmir is primarily famous for conserving which endangered species?
extraction_results.e: Dachigam National Park near Srinagar is the primary habitat and conservation area for the critically endangered Hangul, or Kashmir Stag.

extraction_results.t: In Microsoft Word, which keyboard shortcut is used to undo the last action?
extraction_results.e: Pressing Ctrl + Z in Microsoft Word and other MS Office applications undoes the most recent action.
